operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: retain the exact source, private settings and a native export; restore only into empty resources, run owner setup, re-export and compare supported data, then verify the live revision, inbox and owner sign-in before switching traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes. Durable live snapshots and pending enquiry receipts require separate custody; do not claim native archive coverage for them.
